title: The anchor correction
body: Do not plan around a November Pingxi Sky Lantern Festival. New Taipei City's official 2026 announcement puts the festival on Feb 27 and Mar 3. For Nov 10–17, the real lantern activity is an ordinary sky-lantern release at Shifen Old Street; Jiufen is a separate old-town and tea-house stop.

title: Entry & arrival
body: US ordinary-passport holders are visa-exempt for up to 90 days. From Taoyuan Airport, Airport MRT is the default: A1 Taipei Main ↔ A12 Terminal 1 is {{fact:airport-mrt-a1-a12}}. Once in Taipei, MRT single rides are {{fact:metro-single-fare}}.
